description: Scaffold the CDK Python app and build NetworkStack + DataStack, the FFmpeg pin + fetch script, the committed CloudFront public key, and the Python test/lint tooling. This is the foundation all later FEATs reference. Grounded in DESIGN.md sections: Overview + Language note, Named resources, CDK stack decomposition, VPC/subnet/NAT/VPC-endpoint layout, VPC security groups, SQS + DLQ, S3 lifecycle, DynamoDB, FFmpeg sourcing + downscale (pin + fetch), CloudFront signing-key lifecycle (public key only), Clean teardown + outputs.
steps: Create projects/video-streaming-app/iac/ as a CDK Python app: app.py instantiates VideoNetworkStack, VideoDataStack, and (import-only for now; implemented in FEAT-005) VideoAppStack, each with explicit env=Environment(account='678602035067', region='us-east-1'); cdk.json with "app": "python3 app.py"; requirements.txt (aws-cdk-lib>=2.170.0,<3, constructs>=10.0,<11); requirements-dev.txt (pytest, ruff, mypy); .gitignore (cdk.out/, assets/ffmpeg/bin/, .venv/, __pycache__/, frontend/config.json). Until FEAT-005 lands, app.py may guard the AppStack import so synth of the two implemented stacks works; do not leave a NameError.

Implement iac/stacks/network_stack.py: one VPC 10.0.0.0/16 across 2 AZs, defined IN-STACK (no from_lookup); public subnets host a single NAT gateway (nat_gateways=1); PRIVATE_WITH_EGRESS private subnets; S3 + DynamoDB gateway endpoints; interface endpoints for SQS, Secrets Manager, ssm, ssmmessages, ec2messages. Three security groups: alb-sg (inbound TCP 80 from the PRIVATE_WITH_EGRESS subnet CIDRs via a select_subnets loop -- NOT 0.0.0.0/0; egress to web-sg:8000), web-sg (inbound 8000 from alb-sg only), worker-sg (NO inbound). NO port-22 ingress anywhere. Expose vpc + the three SGs as attributes for AppStack.

Implement iac/stacks/data_stack.py: four S3 buckets with fixed names video-input/output/site/artifacts-678602035067-us-east-1, BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL, enforce_ssl, encryption S3_MANAGED, removal_policy=DESTROY, auto_delete_objects=True. Input lifecycle: transition input/ to INFREQUENT_ACCESS@30d and GLACIER@90d + abort incomplete MPU after 7d; Output: abort incomplete MPU after 7d. VideoCatalog table: PK video_id (STRING), PAY_PER_REQUEST, removal_policy=DESTROY, GSI by-status-created (PK gsi_pk STRING, SK created_at STRING, projection ALL). VideoQueue: visibility_timeout 900s, receive wait 20s. VideoQueue-DLQ: 14d retention; VideoQueue dead_letter_queue max_receive_count=3. video/cf-signing-key empty Secrets Manager secret, removal_policy=DESTROY. FFmpeg BucketDeployment into the artifacts bucket from Source.asset('assets/ffmpeg/bin') with memory_limit=1024 and ephemeral_storage_size=Size.gibibytes(2). Expose buckets/table/queues/secret as attributes.

Add iac/scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.sh: curl -L the pinned BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds tarball from the lock file, verify SHA256 against iac/assets/ffmpeg/FFMPEG.lock (fail hard on mismatch), extract only ffmpeg and ffprobe into iac/assets/ffmpeg/bin/, and fail loudly if that dir ends up empty. Create iac/assets/ffmpeg/FFMPEG.lock recording tag autobuild-2024-11-01-14-16, asset ffmpeg-n7.1-latest-linux64-gpl-7.1.tar.xz, and its SHA256 (look up / confirm the checksum of that pinned asset; if egress is unavailable record a retryable blocker rather than guessing a checksum).

Add iac/keys/cf_public.pem: a committed RSA-2048 PUBLIC key passed to cloudfront.PublicKey in FEAT-005. Generate a real keypair out of band (openssl genrsa 2048 -> rsa -pubout), commit ONLY the public PEM, and document the generation + where the private PEM goes (Secrets Manager, out of band) in a comment/README note. Never commit the private key.

Add iac/tests/test_network_data.py using aws_cdk.assertions.Template: assert the queue visibility timeout is 900, the DLQ redrive max_receive_count=3, all four buckets have BlockPublicAccess all-true, the table has the by-status-created GSI, and no security group has an ingress rule on port 22.
acceptance_criteria: From a clean venv: pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt succeeds; bash scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.sh populates assets/ffmpeg/bin with ffmpeg+ffprobe; `npx cdk synth VideoNetworkStack VideoDataStack` exits 0 with no credentials configured.
`ruff check .` reports no errors and `pytest tests` passes (all Template assertions green).
No security group in the synthesized template opens TCP 22; all four buckets block public access.
verification: cd projects/video-streaming-app/iac && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
findings:
DONE + VERIFIED. fetch-ffmpeg.sh populated bin/, `npx cdk synth VideoNetworkStack VideoDataStack` exits 0, ruff clean, pytest 5/5. Synthesized templates: 4 S3 buckets all BPA-all-true, no FromPort/ToPort 22 anywhere.

DEVIATION (FFmpeg pin): DESIGN.md/FEAT named daily tag autobuild-2024-11-01-14-16 + asset ffmpeg-n7.1-latest-linux64-gpl-7.1.tar.xz. BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds prunes daily autobuilds (keeps only month-end snapshots for older dates), so that tag no longer exists upstream (404). Re-pinned to the durable Nov-2024 month-end snapshot, SAME FFmpeg n7.1 linux64-gpl build: TAG=autobuild-2024-11-30-13-12, ASSET=ffmpeg-n7.1-39-g64e2864cb9-linux64-gpl-7.1.tar.xz, SHA256=19a559d8ff2e919d9cf50318714f106bea4f4000fef85e3033899a34242e6266 (computed from the downloaded asset; no upstream .sha256 sidecar exists). FFMPEG.lock documents the re-pin and how to bump. Worker (FEAT-002) pulls from s3://video-artifacts-678602035067-us-east-1/ffmpeg/ (BucketDeployment destination_key_prefix='ffmpeg/').

SYNTH QUIRK FIX (later FEATs/convergence must keep): an in-stack ec2.Vpc still queries the availability-zones context provider, which assumes the CDK lookup role and fails when ambient (even stale) AWS creds are present. VideoNetworkStack overrides the `availability_zones` property to return ['us-east-1a','us-east-1b'] so synth stays lookup-free regardless of ambient creds. If VideoAppStack (FEAT-005) also defines/derives AZs or a second networking stack is added, apply the same override there.

EXACT NAMES / CONTRACTS for later FEATs:
- Stack IDs: VideoNetworkStack, VideoDataStack, VideoAppStack. app.py already instantiates Network+Data and guards `from stacks.app_stack import VideoAppStack`, calling VideoAppStack(app,'VideoAppStack', network=<net>, data=<data>, env=ENV). FEAT-005 implements stacks/app_stack.py with that signature (or updates app.py to match) and removes nothing from the guard.
- NetworkStack attributes exposed for AppStack: self.vpc, self.alb_sg, self.web_sg, self.worker_sg. Web app port constant = 8000 (network_stack.WEB_PORT). alb_sg inbound = TCP80 from each PRIVATE_WITH_EGRESS subnet CIDR (the Finding-6/round-3 VPC-origin rule); alb_sg egress TCP8000 to web_sg; web_sg inbound TCP8000 from alb_sg; worker_sg has NO inbound.
- DataStack attributes exposed: self.input_bucket, self.output_bucket, self.site_bucket, self.artifact_bucket, self.table, self.queue, self.dlq, self.signing_key_secret.
- Fixed physical names (account 678602035067, region us-east-1): buckets video-input/output/site/artifacts-678602035067-us-east-1; table VideoCatalog (GSI by-status-created: gsi_pk STRING / created_at STRING, projection ALL, items set gsi_pk='VIDEO'); queue VideoQueue; DLQ VideoQueue-DLQ; secret video/cf-signing-key.
- CF signing key: committed PUBLIC pem at iac/keys/cf_public.pem (RSA-2048, generated out of band). FEAT-005 passes its text to cloudfront.PublicKey(encoded_key=...) and adds it to a KeyGroup. Private PEM goes into the video/cf-signing-key secret out of band via `aws secretsmanager put-secret-value` (documented in iac/README.md); the web tier (FEAT-003) reads CF_KEY_PAIR_ID = the PublicKey's public_key_id for the CloudFront-Key-Pair-Id field (per must_fix HIGH_cf_public_key_id).
- VPC-origin SG (must_fix MED_vpc_origin_sg) is NOT yet verified here; it belongs to FEAT-005. This FEAT only wired the ALB ingress as the concrete private-subnet-CIDR rule the design already mandates; FEAT-005 must still confirm cloudfront.VpcOrigin exists in the installed aws-cdk-lib (installed/verified version here = 2.274.0, >=2.170.0) and that the VPC-origin ENIs source from those CIDRs, on synth.
- Tooling: clean venv install works (aws-cdk-lib 2.274.0, constructs 10.8.1, pytest 9.1.1, ruff 0.17.1, mypy 2.4.0). pytest needs iac/ on sys.path -> provided by empty iac/conftest.py. cdk.context.json is gitignored (always empty because synth is lookup-free).
